name: MY PERFECT DAY
source:
"My Perfect Day" is a visual novel where you can design your own day, choose what you'd like to do, and reflect on what you took from it. Through this game, you meet your new companion, Leafy! He accompanies you on your "Perfect Day" while you journal what your day entailed, with a wide selection of pathways to continue your journey.

This game was created for Hack Club Athena's Sunbeam 2026 @ NYC (and Sunbeam Global) by Felesha Fei, Sophia Huang, and Arisha Islam. Made with sweat, tears, and don't forget love! :D

[From [url=https://blueheart-elf.itch.io/my-perfect-day]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我的完美一天》是一款允许你亲手规划专属日程、自由选择想做的事，并回味自己从中收获了什么的视觉小说。在游戏中，你将结识新伙伴“小叶”！当你记录下一天的点点滴滴时，他会全程陪伴你度过这“完美的一天”，并有丰富的分支路线供你延续这段旅程。

本作由Felesha Fei、Sophia Huang与Arisha Islam为Hack Club Athena在纽约举办的Sunbeam 2026（及Sunbeam Global）活动创作。凝聚了汗水、泪水，当然还有满满的爱意！

[摘自[url=https://blueheart-elf.itch.io/my-perfect-day]itch.io[/url]]
